lines: A CORNERED FOX IS MORE DANGEROUS THAN A JACKAL!
nanite_lines: I NEED HEALING... NEVER MIND, GOT IT!
MY BODY IS MACHINE, BUT MY SPIRIT ENDURES!
PAIN... THIS IS WHY I FIGHT!
STILL STANDING. STILL BREATHING. STILL DEADLY!
THE FLESH IS WEAK, BUT THE NANITES ARE WILLING!
THEY HARDEN IN RESPONSE TO PHYSICAL TRAUMA!
